title: A fleet host can carry any label and its own tracy-web origin, the tracy-host image carries the deploy files a shard syncs, and a shard's own App reads releases with the token
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run the three test files named in run.cmd.
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the named tests.
expect: host-dsh-init.sh --dry-run accepts s1 and a 16-character label and refuses labels outside ^[a-z][a-z0-9]{0,15}$ with exit 2 before anything runs.

--tracy-origin is printed as MCP_TRACY_ORIGIN; without it the default stays https://cowork.tracy.ai with a warning; a path, trailing slash, plain http or upper case is exit 2; a kept file with another origin is named.
--seat-secret-out keeps the secret off the terminal, writes it at 0600 without following a symlink and leaves no temporary file on failure.
A run that would write dsh-passwords.env without an actor secret source, or with an empty one, stops with exit 2 before any output.
HOST_DSH_GATEWAY and HOST_DSH_CONTAINER point the init at a second, prefixed dsh; the defaults are today's single dsh.

apps/tracy-host/Dockerfile copies every file the two deploy actions install plus the listed extras, each a tracked git path, with the commit label after the last COPY; check-fleet-files-in-image.sh compares exactly those files and fails with a diff on drift.

releasesToken uses TRACY_RELEASES_GITHUB_TOKEN only when the App is not installed on the releases repo; an installed App still mints; a refused mint or a GitHub outage surfaces the error, never the token.
fence: The host label (shard name rule), origin, actor-secret and seat-secret-out checks of host-dsh-init.sh; the COPY list of the tracy-host image kept in step with the deploy actions and the check script; the not-installed branch of releasesToken

tests: a shard label the old list never named is accepted, and names its agent hostname
labels outside the shard name rule are refused before anything runs
--tracy-origin is what the dry run says it will write as MCP_TRACY_ORIGIN
an origin with a path, a trailing slash, plain http or upper case is refused
a kept dsh-passwords.env with another origin is named, not silently kept
--seat-secret-out keeps the seat secret off the terminal and says where it goes
step 3a never writes the secret through a symlink
step 3a leaves no temporary file, and no secret, when chmod fails
a run that will write dsh-passwords.env without any actor secret source stops first, with exit 2
HOST_DSH_GATEWAY and HOST_DSH_CONTAINER point the init at a second, prefixed dsh
every file the stack deploy installs is in the image, at the same name
every file the host-dsh deploy installs is in the image, at the same name
every COPY source is a tracked git path, never a glob, so image-context.mjs can fingerprint it
check-fleet-files-in-image.sh compares exactly the fleet files the Dockerfile copies
check-fleet-files-in-image.sh fails, with a diff, when the image drifts from the checkout
an App that is not installed on the releases repo reads it with TRACY_RELEASES_GITHUB_TOKEN
an App installed on the releases repo still mints, token or not (production)
an App installed on the releases repo whose mint is refused surfaces the error, never the token
